name: EGI to mne/raw
summary: Converts an EGI EEG .raw file to MNE-Python raw FIF format with mne.io.read_raw_egi, setting EOG/ECG/MISC channel types, bad channels and trigger events, with a QC report and PSD plot.
description: Reads the EGI recording, combines the listed stimulus channels into annotations or a synthetic STI 014 trigger channel, labels EOG/ECG/MISC channels, marks listed and (optionally) flat channels as bad, and writes raw.fif with an HTML report and a power spectral density figure. Use it as the import step for EGI (Geodesic) EEG data before MNE-based processing.

outputs.description: MNE Raw data in FIF format

parameters.description: EOG channels if any. Default is None.
ECG channels if any. default is None.
Which stimulus channels to include (comma separated list).
Names of channels or list of indices that should be designated MISC channels. Default is None.
Mark flat channels as bad if True (default).
If True, annotations are created from experiment events. If False, a synthetic trigger channel STI 014 is created from experiment events.
